name: AtomStack A24 Pro 1064nm
tagline: Fiber-only A24 Pro : metal and plastic marking in a compact Atomstack
tldr: AtomStack A24 Pro 1064nm is the fiber-marking variant without the diode side : for users who only need metal/plastic marking in a small footprint, not wood cutting.
mainObjective: Desktop fiber marking without a separate diode engraver

engraveExample.description: Filled logo on stainless steel plate

pros: Fiber marks metal : does not cut wood or acrylic
Software listed on the profile : test your workflow (LightBurn or maker app) on scrap first
Work area ~110 × 110 mm marking field : confirm your typical job sizes fit the bed
cons: Does not cut wood, leather, or acrylic : metal marking workflows only
Fume extraction still matters for coated metals and marking sprays
beginnerNotes: This profile covers AtomStack A24 Pro 1064nm. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Rotary and fixture quality matter more than raw wattage for rings and pens.
primaryUse: Compact fiber marking for metal and engineered plastics.

editorialDepth.advantages: AtomStack A24 Pro 1064nm 20W fits shops that mark stainless, aluminum, and tools daily without a CO₂ bay. A solid bench option for jewelry, tags, and small batches.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if wood, leather, or cast acrylic pay your bills. Deep metal cutting and large industrial panels often need more fiber headroom or a different machine class.
